# konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth (Resource)

IdentityPrincipalBasicAuth Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth" "my_identityprincipalbasicauth" {
  directory_id = "30f305d5-c16b-49e7-9c7c-7b672f7e6b73"
  managed_by = {
    key = "value"
  }
  principal_id = "dba80c6a-eafd-4513-95c6-b1e4e2c2095f"
  username     = "...my_username..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory
- `principal_id` (String) Unique identifier of the principal (UUID format)
- `username` (String) The username for basic authentication.

### Optional

- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric character.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth.my_konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    id           = "..."
    principal_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth.my_konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth '{"directory_id": "...", "id": "...", "principal_id": "..."}'
```
